title.en: Explain the meaning and features of GST
Explain the role of chambers of commerce in internal trade

say.en: Before 2017 a truck crossing from Karnataka to Maharashtra faced many different taxes and long waits at check posts. Then came GST. In this lesson: Explain the meaning and features of GST.
Compute CGST, SGST and IGST.
Explain the role of chambers of commerce in internal trade.

body.en: GST is a destination-based tax on the supply of *goods and services*, introduced in India on 1 July 2017 through the 101st Constitutional Amendment. It replaced many central and state indirect taxes. India has a dual GST: on a sale within a state (intra-state), Central GST (CGST) and State GST (SGST) are levied in equal halves; on a sale from one state to another (inter-state), Integrated GST (IGST) is levied by the Centre. Each registered dealer gets a 15-digit GST Identification Number (GSTIN) based on PAN. The GST Council, chaired by the Union Finance Minister, recommends rates.
body.kn: ಜಿಎಸ್‌ಟಿ 2017ರ ಜುಲೈ 1ರಂದು ಜಾರಿಯಾಯಿತು. ರಾಜ್ಯದೊಳಗೆ ಸಿಜಿಎಸ್‌ಟಿ ಮತ್ತು ಎಸ್‌ಜಿಎಸ್‌ಟಿ ಸಮಾನ ಅರ್ಧಗಳಲ್ಲಿ; ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಐಜಿಎಸ್‌ಟಿ ವಿಧಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Goods pass from manufacturer to wholesaler to retailer. Each pays GST on its sale but takes credit for the GST it paid on purchases, so tax falls only on value added. Switch the credit off to see the old cascading effect.
narration.kn: ಸರಕು ತಯಾರಕರಿಂದ ಸಗಟು, ನಂತರ ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರೂ ಖರೀದಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ GSTಗೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಪಡೆಯುವುದರಿಂದ ಮೌಲ್ಯವರ್ಧನೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ತೆರಿಗೆ. ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಆರಿಸಿ ಹಳೆಯ "ತೆರಿಗೆ ಮೇಲೆ ತೆರಿಗೆ" ನೋಡಿ.

title.en: Role of chambers of commerce and industry

body.en: *Chambers of commerce* and industry, such as FICCI, CII and ASSOCHAM, are associations of business firms that interact with the government on behalf of their members. In internal trade they help with smooth inter-state movement of goods, harmonisation of the tax structure, marketing of agricultural products, enforcement of weights and measures and prevention of cheating in brands, promotion of brand equity, better transport infrastructure, and reasonable labour legislation.
body.kn: ಎಫ್‌ಐಸಿಸಿಐ, ಸಿಐಐಯಂತಹ ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಮಂಡಳಿಗಳು ಸರ್ಕಾರದೊಂದಿಗೆ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಪರವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಿ ಆಂತರಿಕ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಸುಗಮವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯಲು ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: A Hubballi dealer sells furniture worth ₹40,000 (GST rate 18%) (a) to a buyer in Belagavi, Karnataka, and (b) to a buyer in Pune, Maharashtra. Find the tax in each case and the invoice total.

steps.en: The total tax is the same; only who collects it changes.

answer.en: (a) CGST ₹3,600 + SGST ₹3,600; (b) IGST ₹7,200; invoice ₹47,200 in both cases.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A Hubballi dealer sells furniture worth ₹40,000 (GST rate 18%) (a) to a buyer in Belagavi, Karnataka, and (b) to a buyer in Pune, Maharashtra. Find the tax in each case and the invoice total.

say.en: Let us work through this together. A Hubballi dealer sells furniture worth 40,000 rupees GST rate 18 percent a to a buyer in Belagavi, Karnataka, and b to a buyer in Pune, Maharashtra. Find the tax in each case and the invoice total.
Total GST equals 18 percent times 40,000 rupees equals 7,200 rupees.
a Intra-state: CGST 9 percent equals 3,600 rupees and SGST 9 percent equals 3,600 rupees; invoice equals 47,200 rupees.
b Inter-state: IGST 18 percent equals 7,200 rupees; invoice equals 47,200 rupees.
The total tax is the same; only who collects it changes.
So the answer is a CGST 3,600 rupees plus SGST 3,600 rupees; b IGST 7,200 rupees; invoice 47,200 rupees in both cases.
